title: ForgeFlow execution liveness v1
objective: Separate durable active lifecycle state from actionable execution liveness and harden Policy graceful shutdown.
architecture_decisions: LangGraph thread status remains durable lifecycle truth; liveness is a read-only operator projection.
Existing activeObjectiveCount remains backward-compatible while actionable and stale counts are added.
Only supervisor-owned active objectives whose configured plan is inactive are stale by this contract.
Policy shutdown tuning changes only systemd stop budget.
protected_contracts: No bulk cancellation or historical thread rewrite is introduced.
Project supervisor timer activation is unchanged.
non_goals: Do not cancel MemoFlow historical objectives automatically.
Do not redesign LangGraph lifecycle statuses.
acceptance_criteria: Summary distinguishes durable active, actionable active, and stale active objectives.
Manual objectives are not misclassified stale solely because continuous planning is inactive.
Policy stop timeout is 60 seconds and controlled restart is graceful.
Focused tests, full pytest, Ruff, and git diff --check pass.

tasks.title: Project effective objective liveness
tasks.goal: Expose stale supervisor-owned objectives separately from actionable execution without rewriting durable thread state.
tasks.why_now: Archived MemoFlow planning is correctly INACTIVE but four September 16 supervisor objectives still inflate the global active count.
scope: Focused operator API tests and documentation.
protected_contracts: Manual objectives remain actionable when appropriate.
implementation_steps: Add failing tests for inactive-plan supervisor objectives and manual objectives.
Expose objective source metadata in the operator view.
Add liveness classification using sanitized project supervisor planning state.
Add actionableActiveObjectiveCount and staleActiveObjectiveCount while preserving activeObjectiveCount.
Document durable lifecycle versus effective execution liveness.
integration_notes: Classification is a projection only and never updates LangGraph thread state.
acceptance_criteria: Supervisor-owned active objective on inactive plan is STALE_PLAN_INACTIVE.
Summary counts accurately separate durable, actionable, and stale active rows.
verification_commands: uv run ruff check forgeflow/operator_api.py tests/test_operator_api.py

tasks.title: Increase Policy graceful shutdown budget
tasks.goal: Allow the LangGraph local Policy process enough time to finish its observed graceful shutdown path.
tasks.why_now: A real restart reached graceful shutdown but systemd killed the old process exactly at the configured 30-second stop timeout.
scope: Post-merge installed-unit reconciliation and controlled restart verification.
out_of_scope: Running the full installer that would activate project-supervisor timer.
protected_contracts: Service security hardening and loopback binding are unchanged.
implementation_steps: Add or adjust deployment test asserting TimeoutStopSec=60.
Change only the Policy unit template from 30 to 60 seconds.
Run focused and full repository verification.
After merge, reconcile the installed unit directly, daemon-reload, and perform one controlled restart.
Verify no new stop-timeout/SIGKILL journal event and timer remains inactive.
integration_notes: Do not invoke deploy/gcp-dev/install.sh for the live-unit reconciliation because it enables project-supervisor.timer.
acceptance_criteria: Template and installed unit report TimeoutStopUSec=60s.
Controlled restart returns service to active state.
No new systemd stop-timeout/SIGKILL event occurs for that restart.
verification_commands: uv run ruff check deploy/gcp-dev tests/test_deployment.py tests/test_deploy_contract.py
